China’s NMPA approval for its Class III ProSense cryoablation system and associated cryoprobes, a major regulatory milestone.
The approval allows ProSense to be marketed in China under the approved registration, expanding IceCure’s commercial reach in a potentially large cryoablation market.
ProSense uses minimally invasive tumor freezing (cryoablation) as an alternative to surgical tumor removal.

title: IceCure Medical wins China approval for ProSense cryoablation system
